subject: Post-call recap & pricing next steps — token benchmarking
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Sam Patel <sam.patel@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-12T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call recap & pricing next steps — token benchmarking

Thanks again for the time today, Sam — good convo. Quick recap and clear next steps so we can get you a target price comparison versus the hosts you asked about (OpenAI / Anthropic) and a recommended Redwood proposal.

Recap (brief):
- Primary use: contextual search + assistant for customer support routing (short prompts, frequent back-and-forth).
- Estimated steady-state: ~25M tokens/month.
- Peak / seasonal: up to ~100M tokens in a month.
- Embeddings: small volume (~3M tokens/month) for similarity ranking.
- Latency SLO: p95 <= 400ms for text completions; embeddings can be batch-run.

What we need from you to finalize benchmarking:
1) Confirm the monthly and peak token estimates above (or share more granular weekly).
2) Confirm your target $/1M tokens that would make Redwood a go/no-go for procurement.
3) Share any mandatory contract terms (POI, required SLAs, length of commit) or procurement timeline.

Attachments: I attached a short pricing card and our benchmark summary (sample runs across 100k–1M tokens). Marissa is cc'd to help with concrete unit economics and commit options.

Next steps:
- Sam: reply with target $/1M and procurement timing (ideally today or tomorrow).
- We: we’ll respond with a short comparison table (Redwood reserved vs hosted) and how that compares to OpenAI/Anthropic on a normalized $/1M tokens basis.

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com | (415) 555-0172

Attachment stubs: redwood-pricing-card.pdf, benchmark-summary-100k-1m.csv

From: Sam Patel <sam.patel@acmecorp.com>

Cc: Acme Corp Procurement <procurement@acmecorp.com>
Date: 2026-10-12T16:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & pricing next steps — token benchmarking

Thanks, Vanessa — good recap. Quick answers below: 

- Monthly: baseline ~25M tokens/month.
- Peak: occasional spikes to ~100M tokens/month (around product launches).
- Embeddings: ~3M tokens/month as noted.
- Budget: for inference only we have a rough target of $20k–$50k/month depending on SLA and commit length.
- Target $/1M: Ideally we’d like to see something around $8–$12 per 1M tokens to fit our internal ROI thresholds — but we’re flexible if there are strong SLA/availability commitments tied to a higher number.
- Procurement timeline: evaluating now, procurement kickoff in ~2–3 weeks, preferred contract start before end of Q4.

Would appreciate the normalized comparison versus OpenAI and Anthropic so procurement can see the delta. We can also share a small prompt set if that helps the benchmark.

— Sam
Sam Patel
Head of Platform Engineering, Acme Corp
sam.patel@acmecorp.com | (212) 555-0199

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Sam Patel <sam.patel@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-13T08:14:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & pricing next steps — token benchmarking

Great — thanks for the clarity, Sam. Based on your target range ($8–$12 / 1M) and volumes, I ran a quick normalized comparison with Marissa and Neha. Below are our assumptions and the high-level benchmarking numbers (all $ per 1M tokens):

Assumptions / normalization notes:
- "1M tokens" normalized as OpenAI-style tokens (approx. 3/4 of word count); we used the same prompt distribution across vendors for the sample set.
- Benchmark excludes embeddings-to-vector storage costs; embeddings listed separately.
- Numbers reflect public vendor list prices + typical host discounts; Redwood numbers show both pay-as-you-go (hosted) and reserved (12-mo commit) offers.

High-level $ / 1M tokens (text completions):
- OpenAI (public catalog average for comparable models): $18.00 / 1M tokens
- Anthropic (public catalog avg): $20.00 / 1M tokens
- Major open-model host (managed Mistral / Llama variants): $10.00 / 1M tokens
- Redwood (hosted, pay-as-you-go): $12.00 / 1M tokens
- Redwood (reserved 12-mo commit, recommended for Acme volumes): $6.50 / 1M tokens

Embeddings (per 1M embedding tokens):
- OpenAI: $7.50 / 1M
- Anthropic: $8.00 / 1M
- Redwood (hosted): $6.00 / 1M
- Redwood (reserved): $3.50 / 1M

Unit economics notes / levers we used to get reservation price:
- Model selection: switching to a quantized open-model can cut inference cost 25–40% with similar quality for your prompts.
- Batching & KV caching: expected token-level cost reduction of ~20–35% on steady-state workloads.
- Commit sizing: your 25M baseline with 12-mo commit + predictable bursts maps to our mid-tier reserved slab; buying a larger commit to cover spike buckets lowers marginal $/1M.

Recommendation (target pricing for procurement):
- If procurement needs a single-line target: recommend we propose $7.0 / 1M tokens on a 12-mo reserved contract (covers text + embeddings blended) with an elasticity clause for spikes. This hits right in your $20k–$50k/month budget at steady-state and provides ~50–65% savings vs OpenAI/Anthropic list.
- If you prefer no-commit flexibility: Redwood hosted pay-as-you-go at $12 / 1M is competitive vs managed open-model hosts and 30–40% cheaper than Anthropic/OpenAI in our sample.

Next steps I propose:
- Marissa: can you prepare a simple 12-mo reserve proposal (sizing options: 25M baseline, 50M baseline, 100M baseline) with expected monthly invoices and an elasticity spike bucket? (attached: proposed-commit-options.xlsx)
- Sam: If you can share the prompt set (or let us use the sample you mentioned) we’ll run a 24–48hr head-to-head to validate numbers.
- Vanessa/Marissa: we’ll produce a one-page comparison slide for procurement that shows $/1M deltas and expected monthly spend under each commit.

If that sounds good, can we tentatively schedule a 30-minute procurement review for Oct 20? I’ll include Marissa and Neha to answer technical and contract questions.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com | (415) 555-0172

Attachment stubs: proposed-commit-options.xlsx, redwood-pricing-card.pdf, benchmark-summary-100k-1m.csv
